guard_streams.source: March 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts

facts.detail: BDUK publishes the March page as monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress data.

The figures are not directly comparable with BDUK official-statistics delivery measures.

The March table reports 1,020,160 contracted premises and 227,310 built contracted premises in total.
